# Avogadro — llms.txt

Avogadro is a standalone Forge 1.20.1 library mod with no Mekanism dependency.
It shows molecule formulas in item tooltips and renders spinning 3D
ball-and-stick models in a panel below the tooltip, plus a JEI "Molecules"
recipe category. Any modpack or mod can add molecules for any item, fluid,
or tag without writing code.

## Where molecule files live

Three sources, merged on the client. Later sources win when ids collide:

1. Datapacks (shared, synced to clients on login and /reload):
   `data/<namespace>/molecules/<path>.json` -> molecule id `<namespace>:<path>`
2. Resource packs and mod jars (client art overrides):
   `assets/<namespace>/molecules/<path>.json` -> same id scheme
3. Local config (per-user overrides, client only):
   `config/avogadro/molecules/<name>.json` -> molecule id `avogadro:<name>`

Invalid files are skipped silently. `/reload` reloads datapack files on the
server and re-syncs them; resource-pack reload (F3+T) reloads asset and config
files on the client.

## File format

One JSON object per file. All fields optional except the geometry source.

```json
{
  "smiles": "CC(=O)C",
  "formula": "C3H6O",  "items": ["mymod:acetone_bucket", "mymod:acetone_bottle"],
  "item_tags": ["c:ketones"],
  "fluids": ["mymod:acetone", "mymod:flowing_acetone"],
  "fluid_tags": ["c:acetone"],
  "match_containers": true,
  "copy": "avogadro:acetone"
}
```

Field reference:

- `smiles`: structure from a SMILES string. Supported: organic subset
  B C N O P S F I, two-letter elements Si Cl Br Na Mg Al K Ca Fe Cu Zn
  and the rest of the element table, aromatic b c n o p s, bracket atoms
  for anything else such as [U] or [nH], bond symbols - = # : / and
  backslash, branches ( ), ring closures 0-9 and %nn, and . for
  disconnected fragments. Chiral @ markers and reaction > arrows are
  ignored. Implicit hydrogens are filled from valence and a force-directed
  layout is applied. Examples: "O" water, "C" methane, "CC" ethane, "C=C"
  ethene, "C#C" acetylene, "O=C=O" carbon dioxide, "N" ammonia, "O=S=O"
  sulfur dioxide, "c1ccccc1" benzene, "CC(=O)C" acetone, "CCO" ethanol,
  "[Na]" sodium, "[C]" carbon, "O[Ca]O" slaked lime.
- `atoms`: explicit geometry, alternative to `smiles`. If both are present,
  `atoms` wins. Array of `{"e": "O", "x": 0, "y": 0, "z": 0}` where `e` is an
  element symbol and x/y/z are floats in bond-length units.
- `bonds`: explicit bonds for `atoms` geometry. Each entry is
  `[from, to]` or `[from, to, type]` with 0-based atom indices. Type is
  "SINGLE" (default), "DOUBLE", "TRIPLE", "QUADRUPLE", or 1/2/3/4, or one of
  -=#. Omit `bonds` to auto-bond atoms closer than 1.3x their summed radii.
- `formula`: display string shown under the molecule in JEI. Omit to
  auto-compute Hill order (C, then H, then alphabetical) with Unicode
  subscripts, e.g. H2O renders as H + subscript 2 + O.
- `items`: item ids that show this molecule, e.g. "minecraft:water_bucket".
- `item_tags`: item tag ids, with or without leading #, e.g. "minecraft:coals".
- `fluids`: fluid ids, e.g. "minecraft:water" plus "minecraft:flowing_water".
- `fluid_tags`: fluid tag ids, e.g. "minecraft:water".
- `materials`: GregTech Modern material ids, e.g. "gtceu:water". Matches any
  item or fluid whose GTM material is listed. Ignored without GT installed.
- `match_containers`: default true. When true, any item holding a bound fluid
  (buckets, tanks, bottles with a fluid capability) also shows the molecule.
  Set false so the molecule only matches the fluid itself in JEI.
- `copy`: reuse another molecule's geometry, e.g. `"copy": "avogadro:water"`.
  Own `formula` overrides the copied one; own target lists are unioned with
  the copied ones. Useful in config to bind new items to an existing shape
  without copying coordinates.

## Resolution order for a hovered item

1. Direct item id match in `items`.
2. Item tag match in `item_tags`, in load order.
3. Fluid inside the item (bucket/tank contents) matched against `fluids`,
   then `fluid_tags`, when that molecule has `match_containers: true`.
4. GregTech Modern material of the item or fluid matched against
   `materials`, then material path against molecule path. Skipped without GT.
5. Fallback: a molecule whose path equals the item path
   (item `mymod:acetone` matches molecule `anything:acetone`).
   Explicit bindings always beat the fallback.

For JEI fluid ingredients the same order applies starting at the fluid step.

## GregTech Modern (soft optional compat)

With GTCEu Modern installed, any item or fluid carrying a GTM material also
matches `materials` entries plus a path fallback on the material name, so
`gtceu:toluene` finds `anything:toluene` with no per-item bindings. Works in
inventories, JEI lists, recipe views, tanks, and cells. Without GT installed
the `materials` lists are inert and nothing else changes.

```json
{
  "smiles": "Cc1ccccc1",
  "materials": ["gtceu:toluene"]
}
```

## Config (avogadro-common.toml)

- `enableTooltips`: show molecules in tooltips. Default true.
- `tooltipSize`: molecule box in pixels, 16-128. Default 64.
- `spinSeconds`: seconds per full rotation, 0.5-60. Default 6.0.
- `jeiCategory`: register the JEI Molecules category. Default true.

## JEI notes

- Item tooltips in JEI gain the formula line, and the 3D panel draws below
  the tooltip wherever Forge fires the tooltip render event.
- The Molecules category lists every loaded molecule with its formula and
  up to 4 representative bound items. Press U on a bound item to find it.
- Category contents are fixed at JEI startup: built-in, asset, and config
  molecules always appear. Server datapack molecules appear in tooltips after
  sync; they join the category after a client restart.
- 1.20.1 has no tooltip-component system, so fluid ingredient hovers cannot
  embed the 3D view: use buckets, tanks, and cells to see the full panel.

## Minimal examples

Bind an existing shape to your items (config/avogadro/molecules/acetone.json):

```json
{
  "copy": "avogadro:benzene",
  "formula": "C3H6O",
  "items": ["mymod:acetone_bucket"],
  "fluids": ["mymod:acetone", "mymod:flowing_acetone"]
}
```

Hand-placed water molecule (equivalent to `"smiles": "O"`):

```json
{
  "formula": "H2O",
  "atoms": [
    {"e": "O", "x": 0, "y": 0, "z": 0},
    {"e": "H", "x": -0.593, "y": 0.459, "z": 0},
    {"e": "H", "x": 0.593, "y": 0.459, "z": 0}
  ],
  "items": ["mymod:water_bottle"],
  "fluids": ["mymod:water"]
}
```

Sulfuric acid with explicit double bonds:

```json
{
  "smiles": "OS(=O)(=O)O",
  "items": ["mymod:acid_bucket"],
  "fluid_tags": ["c:sulfuric_acid"]
}
```
